retraction.reason: Retracted in M41b: the fixed and mobile brand of Altice Portugal, which became the group's operating company when Portugal Telecom wound up TMN at the end of 2014. It is a brand and a subsidiary inside a company the atlas has already retracted for want of anything to join it to, and it would need everything Altice Portugal would need first.
